    Multiplicity-freeness on irreducible components #

    def EFiniteCharacterizations.VertexRepresentation.componentWeightSpace {k R I J : Type u} [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (b : Module.Basis J k R) {d : I → ℕ} {e : I → R} (C : Set (VertexRepresentation d e)) (w : I → ℤ) :
    Submodule k (↑C → k)

    Regular functions on a component transforming by the specified determinant character. Regularity is restriction of a polynomial in the action matrices. The transformation law is imposed on the function itself, independently of its polynomial representative.
